_about: Mixing rules for the Green Sand NIR Reference Library. Maurice Kuubata sets every value in this file; the pipeline only reads it. Change a value here and re-run the pipeline to rebuild everything. Densities in g/cm3, effective grain diameters in micrometres. Values marked provisional in 'status' are awaiting the author's ruling (see docs/VERIFY_CHECKLIST.md Part 4).
composition_basis: clay, seacoal and iron oxide are mass percent of the dry mixture; silica sand is the balance; moisture is mass percent of the wet mixture

silica_sand.label: Quartz GDS74 Sand Ottawa
silica_sand.status: provisional: grain size assumes AFS GFN about 50-60 silica sand

clay.label: Montmorillonite SWy-1 (Wyoming sodium bentonite reference clay)
clay.status: provisional: 10 um treats bentonite as aggregates, not single platelets

seacoal.label: Kerogen BK-Cornell (proxy for bituminous seacoal)
seacoal.status: provisional: splib07 contains no coal; kerogen is the closest organic analog. Effective size calibrated to the Kuubata (2025) measured AUC values

iron_oxide.label: Hematite GDS69 <10 um fraction (proxy for red iron oxide)
iron_oxide.status: provisional: GDS27 (bright synthetic hematite) cannot reproduce the measured positive AUC at any size, so the darker fine natural hematite GDS69 <10 um is used; effective size calibrated to Kuubata (2025) AUC values

water.model: uniform film on all grain surfaces; each grain's single-scattering albedo multiplied by exp(-2 * alpha * film_thickness * path_factor)
water.status: provisional: path_factor 1.0 is the pure geometric estimate, no calibration to measured moist green sand

instrument.name: Avantes AvaSpec-NIR256-2.5TEC (256-pixel InGaAs, TE-cooled) with AvaSphere-50 integrating sphere, as used in Kuubata (2025)
instrument.status: range and pixel spacing (6.93 nm) confirmed from Kuubata (2025) Appendix D; FWHM 15 nm is provisional (depends on slit)

noise_snr_profile._about: Relative SNR across the extended InGaAs range: weaker at both detector edges. Piecewise linear, nm -> factor.

mixing_model_check.status: independent check that Hapke mixing beats linear mixing on a measured USGS mixture; assumes GDS76 was made from GDS27 and fine quartz

lab_calibration.baseline_offsets: one AUC offset per DC2 group, shared by the seacoal and red iron oxide series (they share the same 0% additive spectrum)
lab_calibration.status: provisional: author to confirm the transcribed lab values and the offset treatment
